cards.lean_witness:
by
  constructor
  · simp
  · intro x
    have hd := ((Real.hasDerivAt_exp (k * x)).comp x (hasDerivAt_const_mul k)).const_mul C
    calc
      deriv (fun t : ℝ => C * Real.exp (k * t)) x = C * (Real.exp (k * x) * k) := by
        simpa [Function.comp_apply] using hd.deriv
      _ = k * (C * Real.exp (k * x)) := by ring
